news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.54 loss per share (vs ₹1.28 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.54 loss per share (improved from ₹1.28 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹43.3m (up 28% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹22.2m (loss narrowed 38% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 56% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 29% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: New major risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been substantially diluted in the past year. Increase in shares outstanding: 45% This is considered a major risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). While dilution might not always result in lower EPS (like if the company is using the capital to fund an EPS accretive acquisition) in a lot cases it does, along with lower dividends per share and less voting power

news.title: Shree Rajasthan Syntex Limited announced that it has received INR 107.65625 million in funding from Peppy Enterprises, Manglam Yarn Agencies, Clk Shares And Securities Pvt Ltd, Shree Shyam Distributors And Marketing Private Limited and other individual investors.
news.body: On November 28, 2025, Shree Rajasthan Syntex Limited closed the transaction. The company issued 81,25,000 shares at an issue price of INR 13.25 for gross proceeds of INR 107,656,250. The transaction included participation from  Shree Shyam Distributors And Marketing Private Limited for 5,50,000 shares, Amit Kumar Gupta for 7,50,000 shares, CLK Shares and Securities Private Limited for 500,000 shares, Khurshed Rustom Dordi for 265,000 shares, Manglam Yarn Agencies for 925,000 shares, Peppy Enterprise for 2,000,000 shares, Rajesh Narain 400,000 shares, Yash Kela for 1,000,000 shares, Shatul Kamal Gupta for 660,000 shares, Anish Kishore modi for 1,075,000 shares. The transaction is approved by board of directors of the company.
